issue.title: Stale help PNG goldens: guide_agents and keymaps_changespecs drifted before operator-search work
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_help_panel.py::test_help_guide_agents_png_snapshot tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_help_panel.py::test_help_panel_keymaps_png_snapshot`

`just fix-tui-screenshots -- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_help_panel.py`
regenerates two goldens with content unrelated to the operator-search-motions work:

- `tests/ace/tui/visual/snapshots/png/help_guide_agents_120x40.png`: the Guide
  "Start from the prompt" paragraph now reads "open the prompt bar (pre-filled
  with your last VCS xprompt, if any; `Ctrl+U` clears it) and describe a task"
  where the committed golden has "open the prompt bar and describe a task".
- `tests/ace/tui/visual/snapshots/png/help_keymaps_changespecs_120x40.png`: the
  right column now shows a "Workflows & Agents" section (`r` Run workflow,
  `+` Run an agent, `Space` Repeat last launched VCS xprompt, `Ctrl+G` Edit
  last VCS xprompt, `@` Restore stashed prompt) where the committed golden has
  older rows (`Space` Run agent (home), no `r`/`Ctrl+G` rows, no section
  header).

Both regenerations were reverted to keep the operator-search diff clean. The
fix is to regenerate these two goldens deliberately and inspect the diff
against the guide-text and keymap-binding sources that drifted (likely the
prompt-bar pre-fill and Space-repeats-last-xprompt work).

Reproduced deterministically via a targeted `just fix-tui-screenshots` run on
2026-09-22 (run-dir `.pytest_cache/sase-visual/runs/6c68687378be4028adca1d55c5ec764f`
in workspace `sase_32`; report summary and expected/actual/diff images retained
there). Pixel diffs are stable content changes, not flakes: the old and new
renders differ in text content, and the same diffs reproduce on repeat runs.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Pixel diffs are stable text-content changes (guide paragraph wording, Workflows & Agents keymap rows) that reproduce identically across runs; the committed goldens predate the source changes that rendered them stale.

payload.description: sibling stale-golden report for different PNG nodes; same regeneration remedy, different source drift
Both are ToolRun ownership-boundary defects in the same executor (sase.tool.ownership / executor_process); fixes should land together before monitors wrap commands by default
